air.night_actions: Four to six reconnaissance/harassment sorties from dispersed nodes; no coherent strike package. One to two aircraft are lost or rendered short-repair by interception/operational causes.
air.day_actions: Remaining fighters and water/recon assets continue warning/recontact while US carrier/Gilberts strikes and local CVE pressure suppress launch sites and support nodes.
air.composition_note: Roughly 4-6 of the surviving serviceable aircraft are water/recon types; regional serviceable does not imply availability over the landing beaches.

sensor_C2.target_islands: Primary radar/director systems around the main landing sectors remain largely out. Visual posts, local telephone/runner nets and some DF/radio nodes still provide warning and local fires, not a unified atoll picture.
sensor_C2.outer_nodes: Outer Marshall warning nodes continue to report US air/ship movement but cannot materially restore target-island tactical C2.

submarines.useful_geometry: About 6-8 boats retain useful or near-useful transport/support-lane geometry during 7-Feb after earlier damage, loss and Cabot-diversion effects.
submarines.center_action: One boat reaches a marginal torpedo opportunity against a screened transport/CVE support element but fails to achieve weapon-quality geometry; no US ship hit centered.
submarines.attrition: One boat is depth-charged/air-attacked into a 48-72 hour local unavailability band; no additional submarine sinking forced on the centerline.
